subject: Lanco product updated: US Filter Carbolux 50 M4008

body.name: US Filter Carbolux 50 M4008
body.short_description:
The Carbolux continuously takes a small quantity of electrolyte from the plating solution bath and cools it down to a precisely defined temperature. The resultant crystals are then filtered off and the purified liquor is automatically returned to the bath. The collected waste material can then be easily disposed of in solid form. Automatic batch system. Each batch can handle 16-18 gallons of solution. Depending on temperature of the solution and set temperature, batches range from 45 minutes to over an hour.

Uses R-22 refrigerant. Stainless steel frame, holding tank and mixing tank. 1/2 HP Mixer. 3 Phase.  Digital Controls. Tested.

body.short_description:
Comes with one elbow.

76″ Height with ducts.

A single phase motor on the tube axial fan.

This fan recirculates the air.It pulls the air out of the evaporator and pushes it into the Companion.

body.short_description:
Comes with one elbow.

76″ Height with ducts.

A single phase motor on the tube axial fan.

This fan recirculates the air.It pulls the air out of the evaporator and pushes it into the Companion.

The Companion has a bigradiator (coil) in it and will need to be fed with cool water 80 deg F or colder, cooling tower orchiller etc.

The coil will cool the air and condense distilled water out of the air for reuse.

The cool dry air goes back to the Evaporator to get wet again.  A closed loop air system.

Tested.
